$Comment: Lumber the Sawmill handed over, rung 6 of the sawmill_lumber ladder. Target 'Wood_' on PREFIX catches every species and every cut the mill makes: base yield, the tool-ladder bonus and any find alike. One rung of a ladder: Listing.Chains names the ladder and this rung's place in it, and every rung shares ONE FlavorKey whose {0} is filled from TextArgs.Flavor's @amount, so retuning a rung is editing its Amount and nothing in a language file. Every STATION_OUTPUT criterion carries Qualifier 'Sawmill', so only what this station hands over counts. Its Claim hands over the Millwright's Hatchet (Server/Item/Items/MMO_Tool_Hatchet_Millwright.json), the earned counterpart to the Sawmiller's Hatchet the mill drops by luck: a shade weaker in every channel, and reachable by working rather than by rolling. It sits on this middle rung, not the top, so a steady sawyer earns it in a long stretch of milling rather than a lifetime. An Item reward is fit-checked before the claim goes through, so a full bag parks the claim rather than eating the hatchet.
Name: Sawmill_Lumber_T6
